desc: Three men with distinct special needs unexpectedly fall for the same woman, sparking a unique and complicated love story filled with challenges and emotions.

title: Unakkaga Oru Roja
desc: Kannan, a poor man, is in a relationship with his colleague Meera. However, he abandons her when he gets a marriage proposal from a rich woman.

title: Ratchagan
desc: A man with anger issues falls in love with a woman but later, the lady's father demands him to manage his rage within three months in order to marry his daughter.

title: Chinna Vathiyar
desc: A scientist gets into trouble when he develops a formula that enables the soul to move out of a body and enter the person or animal present in proximity.

title: Engal Anna
desc: Prabhakar and Bhavani are deeply in love with each other. However, lovers turn enemies when Prabhakar's father is falsely accused of killing Bhavani's father.
